_comment: Source of truth for the component library page. Files in dist/ are auto-discovered; this file adds the human bits (name, description, usage, docs). 'usage' is the full per-page snippet using the site-wide loader (pazUse) — the loader lives in the Webflow global footer and pulls each component from the CDN at its registry version, auto-loading CSS where needed. Add an entry keyed by the component's file basename. Omit an entry and the component still appears with embed tags only. Set hidden:true to suppress (e.g. stubs).

tabs.name: Tabs
tabs.description: Accessible tabbed panels, matched by ORDER — the Nth .paz-tab button shows the Nth .paz-tab-panel, so no ids or data attributes to maintain. First tab opens by default (or mark one with data-paz-default). Arrow keys move between tabs (Home/End jump to ends); panels fade in. Optionally swaps a side image per tab: add .paz-tab-media to a box (it can sit outside the tabs group) and .paz-tab-img to one image per tab, matched by the same order. Style everything yourself — the script only toggles an is-active class on the active tab, panel, and image.
tabs.usage:
Plans Claims
Plans content…
Claims content…

modal.name: Modal
modal.description: Accessible modal engine. Auto-injects the close button (no need to add one per modal), closes on overlay click, Esc, or any [data-paz-modal-close]. Open via a data attribute or PazModal.open('id').
modal.usage: Your content here…

carousel.name: Carousel
carousel.description: Touch-enabled slider with autoplay, infinite loop, dots, and responsive breakpoints. Call initSlider(wrapEl, config) once per carousel — the snippet uses querySelectorAll so multiple carousels on one page all initialize. Set peek to leave a sliver of the next slide showing at the right edge as a 'there's more' hint.

searchbar.name: CMS Searchbar
searchbar.description: Client-side search over a Webflow CMS collection. Fetches once, caches in localStorage, filters in-browser. Enter is blocked so Webflow's search page never hijacks it.

glossary.name: Glossary Renderer
glossary.description: Renders a CMS collection as an A–Z accordion glossary, with a built-in loading spinner that clears itself when content arrives.
glossary.dependsOn: Requires the CMS Searchbar script — load it first (nest pazUse) so WebflowCMS exists.

slider.name: Marquee Slider
slider.description: Infinite auto-scrolling strip for logos, testimonials, etc. Two modes, picked with data-slider on the wrapper. Default (attribute absent) is the pure-CSS marquee: continuous scroll, pauses on hover, fades at both edges, paced by data-speed (seconds per loop). data-slider="steps" is EXPERIMENTAL — it advances one item at a time with a dwell between steps, still pauses on hover, and can be dragged back and forth by mouse or touch (it snaps to the nearest item and resumes). The script duplicates your items so the strip stays full — add each item only once.

Logo 1
Logo 2
Logo 3
data-step-duration="500">

loop.name: Content Loop
loop.description: Auto-advancing one-way loop for a stack of content blocks — shows one item at a time, forever. Built for loops that live inside a hidden tab panel: distances are percentages of the track (items are flex:0 0 100%), so nothing is ever measured in pixels and a display:none panel can't break the layout. Indicator dots are generated for you; clicking one animates to that item the shorter way round. Only advances while on screen.

accordion.name: FAQ Accordion
accordion.description: Click a .paz-faq-elem to expand/collapse its .paz-faq-answer; the +/- icon (.paz-faq-btn-wrapper) rotates. CSS-driven open/close via a data-state attribute. Click delegation, so it works for items added later and when loaded late by the loader.
